output.summary: Salt-loving annual succulent found beside saline water in Europe. Its jointed bright-green stems turn red or purple in autumn, and it has tiny scale-like leaves. It is edible raw or cooked and is usually cooked in unsalted water because of its high salt content.
output.edibilityNote: It is eaten raw or cooked and is usually boiled in plenty of unsalted water because the plant is naturally salty.
